Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a mental asylum doctor ordering a schizophrenic patient to take his pills, the patient refuses, and makes him take the pills to prove they are safe. The doctor obliges, but when he opens his eyes, the patient is gone, a figment of his imagination, revealing it was the doctor that was schizophrenic the whole time.  Please use an emoji at the end of every sentence.assistant
response:
INT. MENTAL ASYLUM - DAY 🏥

Dr. Smith, a middle-aged psychiatrist, stands in front of his patient, Jack, a disheveled young man with a wild look in his eye 🤪. Jack sits on the edge of his bed, his arms crossed and a defiant glint in his eye 💪.

DR. SMITH:
Alright, Jack, it's time for your medication. You know the drill 📚.

JACK:
I don't want to take them! They're poison! 💔

DR. SMITH:
(sighing) Jack, you need these pills to manage your symptoms. They're safe, I assure you 🙏.

JACK:
I don't believe you! You're just trying to control me! 🚫

DR. SMITH:
(frustrated) Jack, listen to me. I've been treating you for months, and I know what's best for you. Now, take the pills or face the consequences 🚨.

JACK:
(defiantly) I won't take them!

Dr. Smith's expression darkens, and he takes a step closer to Jack, his voice taking on a menacing tone 😬.

DR. SMITH:
(firmly) Fine. I'll take them myself. (he holds out the pills)

Jack's eyes widen in fear, but he doesn't move.

DR. SMITH:
(menacingly) I'll show you they're safe. (he forces the pills into his own mouth)

As Dr. Smith swallows the pills, his eyes glaze over, and he looks around the room with a confused expression 🤔.

JACK:
(laughing) Ha! You're the one who's crazy! 🤣

Dr. Smith's eyes snap back into focus, and he looks around the room, taking in the familiar surroundings 🏥. But something is off. The furniture seems different, the colors are muted, and the air is thick with an eerie silence 🌫️.

DR. SMITH:
(confused) Where...where am I?

Suddenly, Jack disappears from the bed, leaving Dr. Smith alone in the room 🤯.

DR. SMITH:
(panicked) Jack! Jack, where are you?!

As Dr. Smith searches the room, he realizes that he's the one who's been imagining the whole thing. The pills, the room, the patient - it was all just a product of his own fractured mind 🤪.

DR. SMITH:
(whispering) I'm the one who's been crazy all along... 🤯

The camera zooms out, and we see Dr. Smith sitting alone in the empty room, his eyes fixed on the spot where Jack once was, a look of utter despair on his face 😔.

FADE TO BLACK 🎥
